title: batatas edulis var. porphyrorhiza
intro: Batatas edulis var. porphyrorhiza, commonly known as the purple yam, is a type of plant that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood sugar levels and aiding in weight management. The purple yam's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of the purple yam include diosgenin, a saponin compound with potential anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties.
